 Police investigate after a man's body was found in garbage bags at the corner of E. 93rd St. and Avenue L in Canarsie, Brooklyn on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026. (Theodore Parisienne / New York Daily News) 
 By Rocco Parascandola | rparascandola@nydailynews.com | New York Daily News PUBLISHED: October 30, 2026 at 1:08 PM EDT | UPDATED: October 30, 2026 at 2:34 PM EDT A dead body was found stuffed into a black plastic garbage bag on a Brooklyn street Friday morning, police said.
 A homeless man rummaging through the trash on E. 93rd St. and Ave. L in Canarsie made the grisly discovery at about 9:20 a.m. and flagged down a city Department of Sanitation worker, who called police.
 The victim, an adult male, was found next to a green garbage can, officials said. His name was not immediately disclosed.
 Police investigate after a man's body was found in garbage bags at the corner of E. 93rd St. and Avenue L in Canarsie, Brooklyn on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026. (Theodore Parisienne / New York Daily News) 
 Foul play was suspected, although the city’s Medical Examiner’s office needed to schedule an autopsy to determine how the person died.
 There was no immediate arrest.
 Cops were canvassing the area for surveillance video that captured someone dumping the body by the trash can, officials said.
